content.question: Match each concept related to the curse of dimensionality with its correct description.

answer.Curse of dimensionality: The general phenomenon where machine learning algorithms deteriorate in performance as the number of features increases.
answer.Data sparsity: In high-dimensional spaces, points spread out so much that the number of samples needed to maintain a given density grows exponentially with the number of dimensions.
answer.Hughes phenomenon: Adding more features improves performance up to a point, after which the model starts fitting noise instead of the underlying signal.
answer.Dimensionality reduction: A strategy that combats the curse of dimensionality by selecting or transforming features to reduce the number of dimensions.
